explosion.description: any explosion ($9EF5 -> $9C94): object destroyed, reactor hit spark, ship death; voice 1

thrust_held.description: thrust held: game re-triggers each game tick (~every 1.5 IRQ frames); simulated every 2 frames for 30 frames

shield_held.description: shield/tractor held ($97D9 -> $9D07, only on game ticks where ($1A&2)!=0); simulated every 3 frames for 30 frames

ping.description: voice-3 ping ($9C75): countdown tick ($9DD1, once per countdown digit)

fuel_or_pod_pickup.description: $9DC4 = ping now + second ping 9 IRQ frames later ($9B4A=9): fuel cell emptied, pod attached
